pages.title: One Crystal, Many Machines
pages.text: A wireless crystal avoids covering every machine face with Direct I/O crystals. Binder-link it into the crystal network, select it with the Binder, then use each target machine in turn—no crystal needs to touch them.

pages.title: Limits in the Margin
pages.text: Sneak-use the crystal empty-handed to switch mode. $(bold)Input$() pulls from targets; $(bold)Output$() sends to them.$(br2)Measured limits: Draconium supports 4 targets and 4 crystal links; Wyvern 8 and 8; Draconic 16 and 16. Their ranges are 32, 64, and 127 blocks.
